summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of the Rulebook Intelligence System. Backend pytest suite (8 tests) 100% pass including all three classification states, empty-question 400, rulebook/stats structure, evaluation questions count, and full 25-question evaluation run. Frontend Playwright E2E validated Ask tab (loading -> state badge + evidence/conflict/missing sections for ANSWERABLE/CONTRADICTORY/NOT_ANSWERABLE), example-question chip populates the input, Browse Rulebook tab (18 chapter nav entries, search filter, conflict flag), and Accuracy Evaluation tab (25 result rows, 3 state metric cards, overall 100% accuracy in this run).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py, retrieval.py, reasoning.py, rulebook_data.py all under reasonable sizes; consider splitting rulebook_data.py if it grows further.
Evaluation endpoint is slow (~60-90s); consider async job pattern + polling for better UX rather than a single blocking POST if scale increases.
Grounding validation (_validate_grounding dropping hallucinated rule_ids) is a strong anti-hallucination measure and worked in all tested cases.
top_k=10 change plus GRAD-007 vocabulary enrichment produced 8/8 contradictory recall in this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_rulebook_api.py; run with pytest. External URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Evaluation run may take 60-120s and is non-deterministic (LLM), threshold set to >=0.75. All data-testids described in the review request are present and functional.
